name: uhL (case 1)
description: half-saturation light intensity at current temperature (Chalker 1980)

name: aLLim (case 1)
original_formula: aLLim= 1.0_rk /(extc * dz) * log((1.0_rk + uLPARSurf / uhL) / (1.0_rk + aLPARBot /uhL))
code_implementation: aLLim= 1.0_rk /(extc * dz) * log((1.0_rk + uLPARSurf / uhL) / (1.0_rk + aLPARBot /uhL))

name: uOpt (case 2)
description: optimal light intensity at current temperature (Klepper 1988)

name: aLLim (case 2)
original_formula: aLLim = exp(1.0_rk) /(extc * dz) *(exp(- aLPARBot /uOpt) - exp(- uLPARSurf /uOpt))
code_implementation: aLLim = exp(1.0_rk) /(extc * dz) *(exp(- aLPARBot /uOpt) - exp(- uLPARSurf /uOpt))

name: aLLimShootVeg
description: light limitation of shoots (with self-shading & surface cover)
original_formula: fEmergVeg + fFloatVeg*(1.0 - afCovEmergVeg) + bfSubVeg*(1.0 - afCovSurfVeg)*1.0/(extc*cHeightVeg)*log((1.0 + aLPAR1Veg/uhLVeg)/(1.0 + aLPAR2Veg/uhLVeg))

code_implementation: aMuTmLVeg = ufDay * bfShootVeg * aLLimShootVeg * uFunTmProdVeg * self%cMuMaxVeg
